  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Card
    Represents a single playing card, defined by its Rank (2-10, J, Q, K, A) and Suit (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades).
    Deck
    Represents the draw deck used during a match: a standard 52-card deck (one Card per combination of Rank and Suit), implemented as a Stack so that drawing always removes the card on top.
    GameConstants
    Centralizes the configuration constants used throughout the game, so that game-balance values are not scattered as magic numbers across the codebase.
    GameModel
    Orchestrates a single Cincuentazo match: holds the list of players, the deck, the table pile, and the turn order, and exposes the operations needed to drive the game loop (advancing turns, eliminating players, detecting the winner).
    HumanPlayer
    Represents the player controlled by the person in front of the computer.
    MachinePlayer
    Player controlled by the computer (AI).
    Player
    Abstract base class representing a player in a Cincuentazo match.
    TablePile
    Represents the central discard pile on the table, where every played card is stacked and whose values accumulate into a running total (getCurrentSum()).
